title: The Worthy cause of the village
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：worthy　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 worthy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of ① a worthy cause of the village in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② worthier than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the worthy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the worthiest cause of the village anybody in the harbour had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too worthy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the worthy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a worthy man of the parish, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as worthy as the man of the parish they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was worthy or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something worthy, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite worthy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the worthy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, before dawn, she wrote of another worthy cause of the village in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ worthier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The worthiest man of the parish in the whole harbour, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the worthy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 值得（前置定语 a worthy cause of the village：1957 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件值得的事业）
B. adj. 值得／可敬（比较级 worthier than：文中两处，一处比村里值得支持的事业，一处比预想）
C. adj. 值得／可敬（最高级 the worthiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 值得（表语 too worthy to do：母亲觉得它太值得，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 可敬（前置定语 a worthy man of the parish：叔叔把整件事称作一桩可敬的人）
F. adj. 可敬（同级比较 as worthy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩教区里可敬的人相比）
G. adj. 可敬（后置定语 something worthy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 可敬（受程度副词修饰 quite worthy：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a worthy cause of the village
the worthiest cause of the village anybody
a worthy man of the parish
The worthiest man of the parish in

answers.why: worthy 意为“值得”，1957 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件值得的事业”，此处作前置定语 a worthy cause of the village。
worthy 意为“值得”，此处用比较级 worthier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
worthy 意为“值得”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说它是渔港里最值得的一件，故用最高级 the worthiest cause of the village。
worthy 意为“值得”，母亲认为这件东西“太值得了，谁也用不上”，too worthy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
worthy 意为“可敬”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩可敬的人”，此处作前置定语 a worthy man of the parish。
worthy 意为“可敬”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩教区里可敬的人一样可敬”，同级比较用 as worthy as。
worthy 意为“可敬”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“可敬的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something worthy。
worthy 意为“可敬”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当可敬”，quite 修饰原级 worthy。
worthy 意为“可敬”，1967 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要可敬”，故用比较级 worthier than。
worthy 意为“可敬”，母亲 1969 年说的是“整个渔港里最可敬的那一桩”，故用最高级 the worthiest man of the parish。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件值得的事业。（a worthy cause of the village）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更值得。（worthier than …）
母亲觉得它太值得，谁也用不上。（too worthy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩可敬的人。（a worthy man of the parish）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩教区里可敬的人一样可敬。（as worthy as …）
到了 1964 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件可敬的东西。（something worthy）
answers: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of a worthy cause of the village in the logbook.
Everybody said it was worthier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too worthy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a worthy man of the parish.
He said nobody would call it as worthy as the man of the parish they had once had.
By 1964 the logbook asked for nothing but something worthy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 worthy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the fisherman wrote of a worthy cause of the village in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the worthiest cause of the village in the harbour, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too worthy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a worthy man of the parish, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite worthy, and everybody laughed.
The worthy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
